## Flagship: Which NIH projects lead to patents or high-impact papers?

### Question
Using only what is known when a project is funded, can we predict which projects will lead to a patent or highly cited papers?

### Data
NIH RePORTER project features, iCite Relative Citation Ratio (RCR), and PatentsView links. [Record counts]{.todo}

### Method
- Random forest and XGBoost, with a logistic regression baseline
- Time-based split (train on earlier years, test on later) to avoid leakage
- SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations) to show which features drive each prediction
- Metrics: precision, recall, and area under the precision-recall curve (rare outcome)
